setlist_extra.title: Going Down the Road Feelin' Bad

liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Box of Rain**: rare: 11 archived performances [11]
- **Goin' Down the Road**: rare: 5 archived performances [11]

## The recordings

- **deadandco2016-06-26.spyder9.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **deadco2016-06-26.deadco2016-06-26.flac24**: audience recording; 17 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **DeadCompany2016-06-26**: source not stated; 18 songs; 185 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds good, with very little audience noise as far as they have heard [5]
- **deadco2016-06-26.deadco2016-06-26.flac16**: audience recording; 17 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this show as a birthday trip to New York City, and also saw the Hartford show on 6/28 [6]
- This was the second night of a two-show New York run on June 25 and 26, 2016 [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadandco2016-06-26.spyder9.flac16**: taped by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; transferred by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; source: Nakamichi CM-1000 CP-101 (Sank P48) > Shure FP24 > Sony PCM-M10 (24/44.1) [1]
- **deadco2016-06-26.deadco2016-06-26.flac24**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by StPatric; source: AUD > 24 bit [2]. Also: Recorded from the front-of-board GA pit with Gefell M210 mics into Oade M248 and SD722, 24-bit/48k, by Jon Pasternak [2]
- **DeadCompany2016-06-26**: taped by Jay; transferred by Jay; source: Source: Schoeps MK4's>Schoeps CMR's>Naiant PFA>Edirol R-44 OCM [4]
- **deadco2016-06-26.deadco2016-06-26.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by StPatric; source: AUD > flac16 [3]
